reviews.title: Loud, Inappropriate Ads in a Sacred Space
reviews.text:
The ad placement in this app is completely unacceptable. There are loud, overwhelming ads—some with music and others featuring inappropriate/haram content—popping up even while trying to read the Holy Quran.

Keep in mind that this content is sacred, and not something the developers created. Monetizing it with invasive ads ruins the spiritual experience. Offering optional subscriptions for extra features, widgets, or adding a donation button would be completely understandable—but ruining Quran recitation with ads shows a complete lack of respect for the user and the text.

I am deleting this app. There are plenty of better, free alternatives available (like Manar).

reviews.text:
You keep resetting my salah correction. I keep missing my salah because of this!!! Not only this, but the ads, I just to read a prayer, but no, I must be met with 3 ads that I can’t skip.


Please stop resetting my salah time. What is the point of the feature if you will make me miss my salah either way? I’m deleting this app until you fix this.
